title: In You, O LORD, I Have Taken Refuge from My Youth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an older Israelite worshipper stands beside a sturdy stone refuge overlooking the hills of Judah. His hair is beginning to turn gray, and his face shows the marks of a long life, yet his posture is steady as he prays for God to be his rock of habitation and deliver him from the hands of the wicked. A younger companion stands a short distance away, listening respectfully. Through a natural progression within the scene, show a subtle memory of the same man as a child beside his family in an ancient Israelite courtyard, where an elder taught him to pray and trust the LORD. The childhood memory should blend gently with the present rather than appear as a supernatural apparition. The panel communicates a lifetime of dependence on God, from the earliest years through old age. Use historically plausible clothing and buildings from the ancient Near East, realistic stonework, olive trees, and warm natural light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Do Not Cast Me Away in the Time of Old Age
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an elderly Israelite man sits on a low stone bench beside the doorway of his home. His shoulders are slightly bent, his hands rest on a walking staff, and his expression reveals concern about becoming weak while hostile people discuss him nearby. A few younger men stand on the street, exchanging doubtful looks and speaking in low voices, while a loyal neighbor brings water and sits beside him. The older man turns his face toward the open sky in prayer, asking God not to forsake him when his strength fails. The composition should emphasize human vulnerability in old age without presenting age as shameful. Beyond the street, a small sanctuary courtyard is visible, where worshippers continue praising God. The warm light entering the doorway symbolizes hope that God's strength remains dependable even when human strength diminishes. Historically plausible garments, walking staff, clay jar, woven mat, stone walls, and realistic faces. No modern furniture, medical devices, text, or fantasy imagery.

title: I Will Hope Continually and Declare Your Strength
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the elderly Israelite worshipper from the previous panel stands in a courtyard among younger families, choosing to speak about God's righteousness and mighty works rather than withdrawing into silence. His walking staff rests against a stone pillar as he gestures gently toward the sanctuary and then toward the children gathered nearby. An older companion listens, while a young person asks a question and receives a thoughtful answer. The elderly worshipper's expression is animated with conviction despite his age, illustrating his desire to proclaim God's strength to the next generation. In the background, olive trees and terraced fields reflect the continuity of life in the land. The visual theme is intergenerational witness: the faithful person remembers the LORD's works and seeks to tell those who come after him. Avoid depicting the speaker as physically invulnerable or claiming that age removes all hardship. Ancient Israelite garments, simple stone architecture, natural daylight, and realistic posture. No modern teaching aids, text, or fantasy effects.

title: You Will Revive Me Again
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an elderly Israelite worshipper stands on a ridge overlooking a valley where new green growth has appeared after a difficult season. His face shows gratitude and renewed confidence as he remembers God's righteousness and expresses hope that God will revive him again. Below, musicians gather with a lyre and hand drum, and several families prepare to join in thanksgiving. The older man speaks about God's faithful works while a child listens beside him. The composition should evoke both past troubles and the promise of future restoration, using the transition from shadowed rocky ground to a sunlit valley as a natural visual metaphor. There should be no miraculous transformation of the body and no claim that the psalm refers to a specific recovery. The mood is hopeful and reverent, with the elderly worshipper praising God for His faithfulness. Authentic ancient clothing, realistic hills and vegetation, simple instruments, and warm natural light. No modern objects, captions, or supernatural spectacle.

title: Give the King Your Justice
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite king sits in a modest royal court listening carefully to the concerns of ordinary people. An elderly farmer, a widow, and a young laborer stand before him, each receiving a fair hearing while advisers wait quietly. The king wears a carefully woven royal mantle and a simple crown, but his posture is attentive rather than proud. In the background, farmers tend green fields and shepherds guide their flocks along the hills, symbolizing the peace and flourishing that just leadership should bring. A narrow stream runs through the land, reflecting the psalm's image of righteousness flourishing and peace spreading like refreshing rain. The scene should convey a prayer that the king judge the people with righteousness and the poor with justice; it is an ideal of faithful kingship, not a literal record of a particular court session. Historically plausible royal clothing, simple furnishings, stone architecture, and natural sunlight. No modern courtroom objects, readable documents, or fantasy effects.

title: His Rule Reaches Distant Lands and He Rescues the Needy
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a broad ancient Near Eastern trade route winding from the Israelite hill country toward distant deserts, coastlands, and neighboring kingdoms. Travelers arrive with pack animals and gifts, wearing varied but historically plausible regional clothing. Near the road, the king's representatives pause to hear the plea of a poor family whose small store of grain has been unfairly taken. The representative orders the goods returned and ensures that the vulnerable household receives fair treatment. In the far background, messengers from distant regions approach the royal city, illustrating the psalm's expansive vision of rule from sea to sea and the acknowledgment of kings from distant lands. Avoid portraying the passage as a documented conquest or suggesting that all the regions shown were under one historical administration. The central emphasis is protection of the poor, rescue of the needy, and deliverance from oppression. Show realistic pack animals, trade goods, ancient garments, stone roads, and natural light. No modern flags, vehicles, or fantasy effects.

title: May the Whole Earth Be Filled with His Glory
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a sweeping countryside in the ancient Near East showing fertile fields, productive orchards, and a fortified city beneath a vast sky. Farmers harvest grain, workers carry baskets, and families share food with the poor near a village gate. A king stands on a raised terrace with elders, looking over the land with humility as he receives prayers for long life, blessing, and righteous rule. In the distance, travelers from different regions move along roads toward the city, suggesting the worldwide reach of the psalm's hope. The scene should emphasize a flourishing land and the king's responsibility to defend the vulnerable, while avoiding an exaggerated golden age or suggesting that every individual enjoys effortless prosperity. The concluding sense is gratitude to the God of Israel, whose glory fills the earth. Historically plausible agriculture, royal clothing, realistic terrain, and warm natural light. No modern buildings, farming machinery, printed banners, or fantasy elements.

title: I Envied the Prosperity of the Wicked
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worshipper stands at the edge of a busy town square, observing a group of prosperous men who seem to succeed despite their pride and harmful conduct. They wear fine but historically plausible garments and speak confidently while servants carry goods and open doors for them. Nearby, an honest laborer counts a small number of coins and looks tired after a long day's work. The worshipper's face reveals envy and confusion as he struggles to understand why the proud appear secure while upright people face difficulties. One prosperous man gestures arrogantly toward the crowd, symbolizing boastful speech and the attitude that no higher authority will challenge him. The contrast should be morally complex: wealth itself is not proof of wickedness, and poverty is not proof of righteousness. In the background, a sanctuary stands above the town, suggesting the perspective the worshipper has not yet fully gained. Use realistic market goods, ancient clothing, stone buildings, and natural afternoon light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Until I Went into the Sanctuary of God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper moves from a crowded town square toward an ancient sanctuary courtyard. Behind him, prosperous and arrogant men continue their confident conversations, while ordinary people appear drawn to their apparent success. The worshipper pauses at the sanctuary entrance, his face troubled but increasingly reflective. Inside the courtyard, an elder reads from a scroll while several people sit quietly, listening. The worshipper lowers his head and considers the ultimate end of pride and the spiritual danger of judging reality only by outward prosperity. Soft light falls across the sanctuary floor, creating a visual transition from the distractions of the marketplace toward a more serious perspective. Do not show a literal supernatural vision of the wicked being destroyed. The panel should express how entering God's sanctuary changes the worshipper's understanding of the apparent success of the arrogant. Historically plausible Israelite architecture, garments, parchment, oil lamps, and natural lighting. No modern books, readable text, or fantasy imagery.

title: When I Was Envious, I Was Without Understanding
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the same worshipper sits outside the sanctuary on a stone bench, now recognizing the danger of envying those who seem secure while rejecting wisdom. Through the courtyard entrance, a road descends toward a prosperous estate whose owner has become careless and arrogant. Farther along that road, the ground is uneven and the pathway approaches a steep slope, subtly representing how apparent security may be fragile. Do not depict a person falling, being injured, or receiving a literal supernatural punishment. The worshipper looks down at his hands, acknowledging his own bitterness and lack of understanding, then lifts his gaze toward the sanctuary with humility. An older companion sits nearby and listens. The image should communicate repentance for judging by appearances and renewed awareness of God's presence. Use realistic ancient architecture, stone benches, natural shadows, and historically plausible clothing. No modern objects, text, or dramatic fantasy effects.

title: Whom Have I in Heaven but You?
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper stands near the sanctuary courtyard at sunrise, looking over the distant hills with a newly settled expression. His posture is no longer tense with envy; he places one hand against his chest and raises the other gently in gratitude, expressing that God holds him by the hand, guides him with counsel, and remains his portion forever. A trusted elder and a young family stand nearby, sharing the quiet moment. In the distance, the town's market begins to open, but the worshipper's attention remains on God rather than material success. A broad path leads from the sanctuary toward the surrounding countryside, symbolizing the continuing journey of one whose strength may fail but whose heart finds refuge in God. The scene should communicate renewed perspective and closeness to God without showing a physical divine figure. Ancient Israelite garments, stone architecture, olive trees, and golden natural light. No modern objects, captions, or supernatural glow.

title: Remember Your Congregation, O LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a sanctuary in ancient Israel after a devastating attack or desecration. The woven curtains are torn, sections of timber have fallen, and the courtyard lies largely empty. There are no bodies or graphic details. A small group of worshippers stands at a respectful distance, looking at the damage with sorrow and disbelief. An elder holds a broken wooden piece from the structure while a younger worshipper looks toward the sky in prayer, asking why God seems to have rejected His people and why the enemy has destroyed the place where His name was honored. The architecture should remain consistent with ancient Israelite worship, not resemble a later European cathedral. In the foreground, a clay lamp has gone out, symbolizing the interruption of familiar worship, while the sky above the damaged sanctuary remains broad and open. The image should express communal lament, the loss of sacred space, and the plea that God remember His congregation and inheritance. No modern weapons, graphic violence, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: You Are the God Who Works Salvation
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with a wide symbolic landscape. In the foreground, the same Israelite worshippers gather among the damaged stones of their sanctuary, seeking assurance because familiar signs and leaders seem absent. One elder points toward the horizon while praying that God remember His ancient acts and exercise His strength against evil. Beyond the city, the land includes mountains, a river, stretches of wilderness, and a broad body of water, visualizing the psalm's recollection that God divided the sea, broke the power of chaotic waters, established day and night, and set the boundaries of the earth. These elements should be shown as natural landscape rather than literal mythological creatures or modern scientific illustration. Sunlight falls across a distant mountain while the damaged sanctuary remains in the foreground, connecting the Creator's authority over nature with hope for His people. Use historically plausible ancient architecture and clothing, realistic water, stone terrain, and natural daylight. No fantasy sea monsters, modern infrastructure, or readable text.

title: Arise, O God, and Defend Your Cause
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solemn gathering in the damaged courtyard of an ancient Israelite sanctuary. A few worshippers kneel among the stones, one shielding a small oil lamp from the wind while an elder raises both hands in prayer. Others stand together in quiet solidarity, asking God not to forget the cries of the oppressed or allow the hostile forces to mock His name. Beyond the broken courtyard wall, distant adversaries are visible as small figures moving away across a ridge; they do not dominate the composition or suffer physical harm. The focus is the community's plea for God to remember His covenant, defend His cause, and not forget the vulnerable. The sky is overcast but a narrow opening brings natural light onto the worshippers, creating a feeling of unresolved yet persistent hope. Use realistic ancient stonework, simple garments, clay vessels, and restrained lighting. No visible divine warrior, graphic violence, modern objects, or fantasy effects.

title: We Give Thanks Because God's Name Is Near
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public gathering of Israelites in an ancient stone courtyard where people give thanks for God's works and the hope of righteous judgment. Musicians prepare lyres and hand drums, while elders stand before the congregation with serious expressions. A local leader addresses the people, urging humility and warning against arrogant gestures and proud speech. Nearby, a wealthy man lowers his head and listens, while a humble farmer stands among the crowd without seeking special honor. A stone pillar rises beside the gathering, and the surrounding buildings appear stable but not monumental, conveying the psalm's assurance that God governs the appointed time and holds the pillars of the earth. The composition should express thanksgiving, divine nearness, and the warning that no person should lift up their horn in pride. The imagery of the horn represents power and arrogance, not a literal weapon. Historically plausible Israelite garments, realistic architecture, natural afternoon light. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: God Is the Judge Who Raises and Brings Low
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with restrained symbolic storytelling, an ancient Israelite public square where several men of different social standing stand before an elder who listens to a dispute. One influential man appears proud and expects special treatment, while a modest farmer waits patiently. The elder weighs the matter carefully rather than choosing a side based on wealth or status, symbolizing that promotion and judgment ultimately belong to God rather than merely to human ambition. On a low table stands a clay cup filled with dark red grape wine, representing the psalm's metaphor of the cup in the LORD's hand; do not depict people being forced to drink or show intoxication. David or a worshipper stands nearby in reflection, recognizing that pride will not last and that the righteous will give thanks to the God of Jacob. The scene should communicate sober justice without a visible divine verdict or graphic punishment. Authentic ancient garments, pottery, stone architecture, and natural light. No modern scales of justice, readable signs, or fantasy effects.

title: God Is Known in Judah and Zion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a panoramic view of ancient Jerusalem with its stone walls and sanctuary rising above surrounding homes. Worshippers stand on a nearby ridge, looking toward the city and expressing awe at the LORD's presence in Zion. Beyond the city gates, a military encampment sits quiet after a conflict has ended; abandoned shields, lowered spears, and unhitched chariots lie in the dust, with no bodies or graphic injuries. The image evokes the psalm's portrayal of God breaking the weapons and stopping the advance of powerful enemies, while maintaining the dignity of those who survived. The city's residents begin returning to ordinary work, and an elder gathers families in a courtyard to give thanks. The composition emphasizes divine majesty in Judah and God's dwelling place in Zion rather than claiming a precisely identified battle. Use historically plausible Israelite architecture, ancient military equipment, realistic terrain, and natural sunrise. No modern weapons, fantasy effects, or graphic violence.

title: God Judges the Earth and Subdues the Proud
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solemn assembly in an ancient Israelite city after a time of turmoil. Families and elders gather within the city walls while a few former adversaries stand quietly near the gate, their weapons lowered and their posture subdued. The sky is vast and luminous above the city, symbolizing the awe due to the LORD and the divine judgment that no earthly power can evade. An elder speaks to the gathering about making vows to God and bringing gifts with reverence, while a young worshipper listens carefully. In the background, the surrounding countryside is peaceful and the road clear, emphasizing that even the wrath of nations does not exceed God's ultimate authority. Do not depict a visible supernatural judge or dramatize the fate of enemies. The image should be majestic, restrained, and focused on reverence, deliverance, and the limits of human pride. Ancient clothing, stone architecture, realistic landscape, and natural light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy imagery.

title: In the Night I Stretch Out My Hands
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solitary Israelite worshipper sits awake at night inside a modest stone dwelling, unable to find comfort despite praying earnestly. He raises one hand toward the sky and rests the other on his knee, his face tired and troubled. A small oil lamp burns low beside a clay water vessel, and a folded woven blanket lies unused near the wall. Through a narrow opening, the moonlight illuminates the rooftops of a quiet ancient town. The worshipper reflects on earlier songs and wonders whether God's steadfast love and promises have ceased, expressing the painful questions of the psalm without portraying him as abandoning faith. An open courtyard beyond the doorway remains empty, increasing the feeling of solitude. The atmosphere should be intimate, emotionally honest, and subdued. Historically plausible furnishings and clothing, realistic oil-lamp light, and natural moonlight. No modern clocks, electrical lights, text, or supernatural figures.

title: I Will Remember the Years of the Right Hand of the Most High
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the troubled worshipper from the previous scene moves from his dim room into an open courtyard as the first light of dawn appears. He unrolls a simple scroll and sits with an elder who recounts the remembered acts of God in Israel's history. In the background, a group of families begins preparing to travel along an ancient road toward a settlement, suggesting the historical journey of God's people from oppression toward freedom. A broad desert landscape and distant mountains establish the setting without reconstructing a specific event too literally. The worshipper's expression changes from isolation toward focused remembrance as he considers the LORD's works, holiness, and power among the peoples. The image should convey that remembering divine faithfulness helps him face present uncertainty, but it should not imply that his questions have all been answered immediately. Ancient Israelite clothing, parchment, realistic terrain, and natural sunrise. No modern books, maps, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Your Way Was Through the Sea
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with grand historical imagery depicting Israel's remembered passage through the sea. A large group of ancient Israelites moves across exposed ground between towering masses of water, their faces showing awe, urgency, and determination. Families hold children's hands, elders support weary travelers, and shepherds guide sheep and goats along the path. Heavy clouds gather overhead, lightning flashes in the far distance, and wind ripples the water, evoking the psalm's poetic description of storm, thunder, and the sea responding to God's presence. Do not show people drowning or suffering graphic injury. The water should appear natural and immense, emphasizing the scale of the deliverance. No human-shaped deity or visible magical hand appears; the event is presented through the landscape, weather, and movement of the people. The scene connects God's power over the waters with His leading of the people like a flock through Moses and Aaron. Historically plausible ancient clothing, pack animals, rocky shore, and realistic storm physics. No modern objects, fantasy creatures, or graphic violence.
